newsitem.title: AFGHANISTAN: Masood forces say they advancing close to Kabul.
newsitem.headline: Masood forces say they advancing close to Kabul.

text.p: Troops of the ousted Afghan government have advanced to within six km (four miles) of the city limits of Kabul, a spokesman for the former government said on Sunday.
"We are six kilometres from Kabul on the old road (from the Salang Pass)," spokesman Mirabbuddin Astana told reporters.

He said government troops were still 30 km (18 miles) out on the new road which leads north out of the city but had captured important high ground along that road and the way was clear for them to advance.
He said the military commander of the former government forces, Ahmad Shah Masood, had gone forward from Jabal os-Saraj to inspect the new front-line positions.
No independent confirmation of the advance was immediately available.
